title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today’s biggest golf stories.

items.headline: DeChambeau Shocked by LIV Funding Pull
items.text: Bryson DeChambeau admitted he was surprised when Saudi Arabia’s Public Investment Fund quickly pulled LIV Golf funding but remains optimistic about a new team golf business plan and is helping attract new investors.

items.headline: DeChambeau Pushes LIV’s Future
items.text: Following PIF’s funding pull after 2026, DeChambeau is working to raise $250–$350 million for LIV with a reduced 10-event schedule while managing his major chances after missing cuts at the Masters and PGA.

items.headline: Big Names Withdraw From Charles Schwab
items.text: Two major winners recently have withdrawn from the Charles Schwab Challenge just days before the tournament begins, compounding withdrawals including Brooks Koepka’s.
